LESSON: WRITING 6.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing, part of Strand 6 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do pictures make you feel?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify pictures from online and offline sources collaboratively,

2. use pictures from online and offline sources to write a pictorial composition of 60 - 80 words based on the theme,

3. discuss pictures collaboratively and write pictorial compositions of about 60 - 80 words,

4. watch a variety of videos related to the theme and write pictorial compositions collaboratively,

5. generate a wide range of pictures from the internet and write pictorial composition.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify pictures from online and offline sources collaboratively,
2. use pictures from online and offline sources to write a pictorial composition of 60 - 80 words based on the theme,
3. discuss pictures collaboratively and write pictorial compositions of about 60 - 80 words,
4. watch a variety of videos related to the theme and write pictorial compositions collaboratively,
5. generate a wide range of pictures from the internet and write pictorial composition.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner collaboratively discusses and uses pictures to write

composition.

• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to view pictures online and write compositions.

Values:
● Unity: This is promoted as the learner collaborates harmoniously with peers in groups to discuss pictures and watch

videos related to the theme.

● Respect: This is cultivated as the learner engages with peers mutually and accommodates others opinion on varied

issues.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cyber Safety: It is promoted as the learners use internet responsibly to access pictures and visuals for composition writing.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of pictorial compositions to their learning in Kiswahili.
